field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefixed. An honest A~=B (verifier adds nothing even where it discriminates, e.g. base near ceiling) is a COMPLETE, decision-grade verdict.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Records the checkpoint + CUDA verified; pre-empts the silent-missing-resource fabrication mode.
field_principles.random_seed: Determinism precondition for reproducing the graft.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash of the corpus + split; catches silent drift.
field_principles.rerank_lift_vs_vote: pass@1 lift from verifier-reranking vs TRM-vote with CI; confirms the executable verifier discriminates on Sudoku (the contrast to .379's ARC-grid anti-discrimination).
field_principles.rft_vs_ablation_delta: The de-confounded A-vs-B held-out delta with CI: isolates the verifier LABEL's training contribution from generic self-training.
field_principles.verifier_value_added: Bare bool: did the verifier graft beat the vote ablation (A>B, CI-excl-0)? The milestone's headline answer on whether verifier-as-reward is real on an executable domain.

native_training_limitation: native nano-trm full fine-tuning not launched in this bounded run; A-vs-B is the verifier-label versus vote-label deconfound.
